logline: 고래를 잡으러 배에 오른 젊은 선원이, 선장이 마스트에 박은 금화 하나에서 이 항해의 진짜 목적을 본다.
destination: 마스트에 박힌 금화 — 흰 고래를 먼저 본 자에게 주어지는 것
setting: 19세기 중반 낸터킷 항구와 태평양 한복판의 포경선
anchor: a young sailor in a rough wool coat and knit cap, wind-burned face
palette: deep indigo sea, bone white, oil-lamp amber, cold sky grey

beats.beat: 낸터킷 항구의 새벽, 젊은 선원이 부두에 선다.
beats.visual: a young sailor standing on a stone quay at dawn, tall masts crowded behind him, breath steaming
beats.motion: mist drifts off the water, ropes sway on the masts, gulls cut across

beats.visual: coiled tarred rope and stacked oil casks along a wet quay, a sailor threading between them
beats.motion: he squeezes past the casks, a rope coil shifts, water drips from the stack

beats.visual: a young sailor stepping off a gangplank onto a scarred wooden deck, harpoons racked along the rail
beats.motion: the gangplank flexes under him, harpoon shafts rattle, the deck tilts

beats.visual: a tall grim captain crossing the deck with a hammer and a long nail, crew turning to watch
beats.motion: his coat snaps in the wind, the hammer swings at his side, heads turn

beats.visual: a gold coin held against a mast as a hammer strikes it, splinters flying from the wood
beats.motion: the hammer strikes twice, splinters fly, the coin bites into the grain

beats.visual: a captain with one arm raised addressing a ring of sailors on deck, mast towering behind
beats.motion: his arm cuts the air, the ring of men presses inward, sails snap above

beats.visual: a ring of weathered faces tilted upward toward a coin nailed high on a mast, sails beyond
beats.motion: heads tilt back together, the coin glints as the ship rolls, ropes creak

beats.visual: canvas sails filling as a whaling ship pulls away from a low grey coastline, wake spreading
beats.motion: sails fill and snap taut, the wake widens, the coast shrinks behind

beats.beat: 배는 몇 달이고 남쪽 바다를 지난다.
beats.visual: a whaling ship alone on vast open ocean under a huge sky, no land in any direction
beats.motion: the hull rides a long swell, spray bursts at the bow, clouds slide past

beats.visual: a tall white spout rising from dark sea at the horizon, a lookout pointing from the masthead
beats.motion: the spout climbs and drifts sideways, the lookout's arm shoots out, waves chop

beats.visual: three whaleboats dropping on ropes down a ship's side into heavy sea, oars swung out
beats.motion: boats drop jerkily on the falls, water surges up, oars swing outward

beats.visual: oars held still above the water as a wide swell parts ahead of three small boats
beats.motion: oars lift and hold, the water parts in a long line, spray drifts

beats.beat: 창백한 등을 마주한 그들에게 무엇이 남을까?
beats.visual: a sperm whale's blunt square white head and scarred back rising ahead of a small boat, men frozen at the oars
beats.motion: the blunt head pushes upward through the water toward the boat, the boat pitches back, spray hangs

beats.beat: 텅 빈 갑판에 금화만 남아 반짝인다.
beats.visual: an empty ship deck at dusk, a single gold coin still nailed to the bare mast, long shadows
beats.motion: the coin turns slightly as the ship rolls, light fades, rigging creaks

withheld: 배가 부서지고 단 한 사람만 살아남는 마지막
